name: The Grim Mansion
source:
Visit the Grim Mansion, a place for humans and monsters alike, and face your inevitable fate as you try to escape death. Will anyone survive, or will you all meet the same gruesome end?

[From [url=https://hungryhn.itch.io/the-grim-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
参观严峻的宅邸，这里是人类和怪物共同居住的地方，并在试图逃脱死亡的同时面对不可避免的命运。有人能活下来，还是你们都会遭遇同样可怕的结局？

[来自[url=https://hungryhn.itch.io/the-grim-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
